subject: Re: CMMD kickoff — replacing FID in Evalline
body:
Lucia,

Plan:

Staffing — Katya 50% (metric implementation: the JAX/Scenic path, CLIP weight handling for air-gapped jobs where auto-download fails); Amara 40% (Evalline integration, pairing with Tomas's team); Chiara 30% (reference-set hosting + docs).

Dependencies — Tomas has committed an integration slot in April (cc'd). Reference image sets (COCO-derived and two internal) get hosted in Corpus now; Corpus v2's migration freeze is 2026-08-07, so moving the reference-image sets to v2 is comfortably a post-launch task — I've slotted it for July and we don't need to think about it this window.

Compute — trivial: embedding extraction on 4 A100s covers the biggest eval set in under an hour.

Risk — teams gaming the transition by reporting whichever metric flatters them. Proposal: side-by-side is mandatory, cherry-picking isn't an option.

Daniela
